explanations: pollOnce() acknowledges the delivery in a finally block, so it is acked whether the handler succeeded or threw. The broker treats an ack as done and drops the message, so every order that failed while the printer was down was removed from the queue and lost. At-least-once delivery requires acking only after the handler returns normally and nacking (so the broker redelivers) when it throws. The fix moves the ack into the success path and nacks in the catch block.
